anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: And since such are more, the barley loaves happen to be seven, since this is also the full number and that of idleness, according to which number also the greatest crowd having idle hands and not working while it is day turns about.
pass_b_english: And since such people are more, the barley loaves are seven, since this is also the full number and the number of idleness — according to which number the greatest crowd, the one that has idle hands and does not work while it is day, also lives (John 9:4) (Matthew 20:6).
source_text: Καὶ ἐπεὶ πλείους οἱ τοιοῦτοι, ἑπτὰ οἱ κρίθινοι τυγχάνουσιν ἄρτοι, ἐπεὶ καὶ ὁ πλήρης ἀριθμὸς οὗτος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἀργίας, καθ’ ὃν ἀριθμὸν καὶ ὁ πλεῖστος ὄχλος ὁ χεῖρας ἔχων ἀργὰς καὶ μὴ ἐργαζόμενος ἕως ἡμέρα ἐστίν ἀναστρέφεται·
